subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the updated credentialed GitHub Action revisions be approved as one aggregate dependency bump after direct source review and exact-head CI completion?
rationale: The PR changes actions invoked with GitHub App private keys, tokens, and an OpenAI API key; the required direct source and Codex contract inspection was unavailable in this environment.

options.title: Review and retain the aggregate bump
options.body: Inspect the exact pinned revisions for credentialed actions and merge after the current-head workflow suite completes successfully.

options.title: Split sensitive action upgrades
options.body: Land routine non-credentialed action updates separately and defer credentialed action revisions for focused owner review.

recommendation.title: Review and retain the aggregate bump
recommendation.body: Inspect the exact pinned revisions for credentialed actions and merge after the current-head workflow suite completes successfully.

likelyOwner.reason: A history pass is required to identify the workflow-area decision owner safely.
